CREATE TABLE `visual_index_entries` (
  `id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `product_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `product_image_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `media_file_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `hash_bits` varbinary(8) NOT NULL,
  `hash_bucket` smallint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `engine_version` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `representation_version` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `index_version` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `indexed_at` timestamp NOT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_visual_index_product_image` (`product_image_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_visual_index_media` (`media_file_id`),
  KEY `idx_visual_index_bucket_active` (`hash_bucket`,`is_active`,`index_version`),
  KEY `idx_visual_index_product` (`product_id`,`is_active`),
  KEY `idx_visual_index_version` (`index_version`,`is_active`),
  CONSTRAINT `visual_index_entries_media_file_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`media_file_id`) REFERENCES `media_files` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `visual_index_entries_product_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`product_id`) REFERENCES `products` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `visual_index_entries_product_image_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`product_image_id`) REFERENCES `product_images` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
